title: Meine Geschichte: Teil 1
summary: Week 1 capstone — pull the sounds, greetings, sein/haben and der/die/das together, then build your first self-introduction

blocks.title: Rückblick: Woche 1
blocks.body: Erste Woche geschafft! You can now hear German's sounds (long/short vowels, **ä/ö/ü**, the two **ch**s, **ß**, the throaty **r**), **greet** by the time of day with *bitte/danke*, use **sein** and **haben**, say no with **kein** and **nicht**, and give every noun its **der/die/das**. That's the whole foundation in seven days.
blocks.callout: Das ist ein super Anfang. Hol dir einen Kaffee — du hast es dir verdient.

blocks.prompt: How do you say 'I have no time'?
blocks.explain: *Zeit* is a noun, so negate it with *kein* → *keine Zeit* (feminine). Never *nicht Zeit*.
*das Brot* — bread is neuter. Learn it as a pair: *das Brot*.

pairs.left: Hallo, ich bin Jonas. Und du? — casual
pairs.right: Guten Tag, mein Name ist Herr Klein. Und Sie? — formal
pairs.note: One introduction, two levels of formality. Read the room, pick du or Sie.

blocks.scene: Lena sits down next to you at a café and wants to know who this newcomer is.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.target: Hallo! Ich bin Lena. Wie heißt du?
lines.en: Hi! I'm Lena. What's your name?
lines.spotlight: *Wie heißt du?* — "what are you called?", the everyday way to ask a name.

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Hallo Lena. Ich heiße Sam. Ich bin aus Toronto.
lines.en: Hi Lena. My name is Sam. I'm from Toronto.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.target: Schön! Und was machst du hier in Berlin?
lines.en: Nice! And what are you doing here in Berlin?

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Ich lerne Deutsch. Es ist schwer, aber schön.
lines.en: I'm learning German. It's hard, but nice.
lines.spotlight: *Ich lerne Deutsch* — your core self-intro line from now on.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.target: Super! Dein Deutsch ist schon gut, echt.
lines.en: Great! Your German is already good, really.

questions.q: What is your name in the dialogue?
What are you doing in Berlin?

blocks.title: Meine Geschichte — Teil 1
blocks.prompt: Build your first self-introduction: your name, where you're from, and that you're learning German.
blocks.sample: Ich heiße Sam, ich bin aus Toronto und ich lerne Deutsch.

blocks.prompt: Meine Geschichte, Woche 1! Write your first self-introduction in full: your name, where you're from, and that you're learning German. Then add one thing about how you are or what you have today, using sein or haben. Erste Woche geschafft — stark!
